hunks.new:
# jobrunner

Small job runner with a configurable, bounded exponential retry policy.

## Retry policy

`RetryConfig::new(max_attempts, base_delay_ms, max_delay_ms)` configures the
runner. `max_attempts` includes the initial call. Only `RetryError::Transient`
failures are retried; permanent failures are returned immediately. Before each
retry, the runner sleeps for `base_delay_ms`, then doubles the delay for the
next retry. Delays are capped at `max_delay_ms`, including configurations whose
values would otherwise overflow a `u64`.

Delays are sent to the injected `Sleeper`, so applications can provide a real
sleeper and tests can use `FakeSleeper` without waiting.

# jobrunner

attempt and never waits. Configuration currently exposes `max_attempts`
and `base_delay_ms` only.
